title.narrative: Danish Support for SDG 13 and SDG 16

description.narrative: CSOs working in SDG16 and in SDG13

Ghana faces severe economic and political challenges, and in the run up to the 2024 presidential and parliamentary elections, tensions are likely to increase. The negative impacts of climate change contribute to these tensions but are seldom addressed in public debate. This project will provide small-scale grant support to national and local civil society organisations to protect Ghana’s democratic and human rights advancements in an otherwise democratically challenged region as well as increasing the focus on climate change issues.
The Embassy in Ghana has received an allocation of DKK One million from the SDG Opportunity Window to undertake activities in support of SDG 13 and SDG 16.

To build capacity and support the efforts of local actors in increasing awareness and engagement regarding climate change issues in the political debate, as well as addressing challenges within democracy, civic space, freedom of speech and human rights.
